recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，不是形態學影像：淋巴球門控下 CD2 對 CD7 雙參數圖，可見一群 CD2 與 CD7 皆表現的族群（綠色），與 CD2 較亮的 T 細胞（藍色）部分重疊，左下角為 CD2−/CD7− 族群（洋紅色）。需配合 CD3、CD16、CD56、CD57、KIR 等標記判讀 NK 細胞增生。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD2-PC7 (y-axis) versus CD7-APC700 (x-axis), log scale
Green population: CD2 positive (slightly dimmer than blue population) and CD7 positive, forming a dense cluster
Blue population: CD2 brighter, CD7 positive, overlapping the green cluster (likely T cells)
Magenta population in lower-left quadrant: CD2 negative, CD7 negative (likely B cells), with a minor tail of events
No distinct CD7-negative or CD2-negative abnormal population is evident on this single plot; color-to-lineage assignment is inferred
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes displays CD2 versus CD7. A dense population (green) expresses CD2 and CD7 and overlaps with a CD2-brighter population (blue), while a separate CD2-negative/CD7-negative population (magenta) lies in the lower-left quadrant. Lineage assignment of the colored populations is not labeled and must be inferred from the full panel; in the reference case, the green events presumably represent the expanded NK-cell population. This single plot cannot establish the diagnosis alone; NK-cell clonality/abnormality should be supported by CD3-negative, CD16/CD56 expression patterns, CD57, and restricted KIR isoform expression, together with a persistent (>6 months) NK lymphocytosis, consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are surface CD3+ with TCR alpha/beta (or gamma/delta) expression and clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas CLPD-NK cells are surface CD3-negative.
Reactive NK expansions are transient with polytypic KIR expression and normal CD56/CD16/CD94 patterns, lacking the persistent restricted KIR or aberrant antigen loss seen in CLPD-NK.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia presents with fulminant illness, EBV positivity, and often CD56-bright atypical cells, unlike the indolent course of CLPD-NK.
